'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Siege of Gaza City]]
*****[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] and tanks continue to [[Encirclement|encircle]] [[Gaza City]], with heavy clashes reported on the city's outskirts. [[Hamas]] and [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] say that they are using [[Palestinian tunnel warfare in the Gaza Strip|"hit-and-run attacks" from tunnels]] to attempt to stop the advance. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-says-israels-strikes-refugee-camp-kill-more-than-195-people-2023-11-02/ (Reuters)]
***[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
****[[Hezbollah]] launches a [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] attack on an [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] [[barracks]] in [[Shebaa Farms]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-says-it-attacked-israeli-position-using-drones-2023-11-02/ (Reuters)]
****Four people are killed in {{ill|Wadi Saluki|he| נחל סלוקי}}, [[Lebanon]], during a shelling by Israeli soldiers. Hamas also launches 12 rockets from southern Lebanon towards [[Kiryat Shmona]], wounding two people. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/mena/lebanon/2023/11/02/hezbollah-lebanon-israel-hamas-escalation/ (The National)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[Turkish-Palestinian Friendship Hospital]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza's]] only medical facility serving [[cancer]] patients, is forced to suspend operations after running out of fuel. Sixteen of the Gaza Strip's 35 hospitals and more than 50 of its 72 primary healthcare clinics are now unusable. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/1/gazas-only-cancer-treatment-hospital-shuts-down-after-running-out-of-fuel (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes]]
****[[31 October 2023 Jabalia refugee camp airstrike]]
*****The [[United Nations]] [[Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights|Human Rights Office]] says that Israeli attacks on the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] may be "disproportionate attacks that could amount to [[war crime]]s". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/2/un-rights-office-says-israeli-attacks-on-jabalia-could-be-war-crime (Al Jazeera)] 
*****[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] says that attacks on the refugee camp are "horrific and appalling". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/2/un-rights-office-says-israeli-attacks-on-jabalia-could-be-war-crime (Al Jazeera)] 
*****The number of victims of the Israeli bombings of the refugee camp exceeds 1,000 with 195 confirmed killed, 120 still missing, and at least 777 injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)]
***[[UNICEF]] estimates that more than 3,500 children have been killed during the war, saying that "children have endured too much already, the killing and captivity of children must stop". [https://www.thecourier.com.au/story/8409091/relief-as-australians-leave-gaza-through-rafah-crossing/ (''The Courier'')]
***Israel strikes a [[UNRWA]] [[schoolyard]] in the [[Al-Shati refugee camp]] where thousands of [[Forced displacement|displaced]] people are taking shelter. The strikes come after five Palestinians were killed in an earlier raid targeting areas near the school. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)] 
***Eleven bakeries in Gaza have been destroyed in airstrikes during the war, according to the [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs|UN relief agency]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)]
***At least 9,061 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since the war began, including at least 3,760 children. [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-jabalia-strikes-731666 (The Business Standard)] 
***Two Palestinians are killed and six others are injured in Israeli raids in [[Qalqilya]] and [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)] 
***Three Palestinians from [[Birzeit University]], including the head of the [[student organisation]], are arrested in raids in Ramallah. [https://bnn.network/world/palestine/israeli-forces-arrest-birzeit-university-student-council-president-amid-tensions/ (BNN)]
***At least 60 people are detained overnight across the West Bank. The total number of Palestinians detained since the war started now exceeds 1,800 with about half of them being held in [[Palestinian prisoners in Israel|administrative detention]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[China]] calls for an "immediate [[ceasefire]]" in [[Myanmar]] after rebels capture several towns near [[China–Myanmar border|the Chinese border]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-11-02/china-urges-myanmar-cease-fire-as-rebels-take-key-border-outpost (Bloomberg)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Labor, Social Affairs and Social Services|Ministry of Labor]] reports that the country's [[agricultural]] sector is suffering "significant damage" due to an exodus of thousands of [[foreign workers]]. More than a quarter of the nearly 30,000 foreign workers have left the country and about 20,000 Palestinian agricultural workers have not been allowed to enter Israel. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/2/israel-hamas-war-live-195-killed-120-missing-in-jabalia-strikes (Al Jazeera)] 
*American [[amusement park]] company [[Six Flags]] announces an [[United States dollar|$]]8 million deal to merge with [[Cedar Fair]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/02/business/six-flags-cedar-fair-merger.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–24 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Ciarán]]
***Storm Ciarán impacts [[northwestern Europe]], killing six people, including two in [[Belgium]], two in [[France]], and one each in [[Spain]] and the [[Netherlands]], and causing mass disruption to transport. Widespread damage from {{conv|100|mph|kph}} winds are reported in the [[Channel Islands]], while 1.2 million [[France|French]] households are left without electricity. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/environment-agency-channel-islands-jersey-caroline-abrahams-age-uk-b2440244.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/storm-ciaran-lashes-northern-europe-with-strong-winds-rain-one-killed-france-2023-11-02/ (Reuters)]
***Six people are killed during heavy rains in the region of [[Tuscany]], [[Italy]], with [[river]]s [[flood]]ing and causing damage. Several roads and [[highway]]s are closed amid [[landslide]]s, and dozens of buildings are damaged. Severe damage also occurred in [[Campobasso]], [[Molise]], evacuations are being made in [[Veneto]] with highways being closed, and emergency calls occurred in [[Rome]]. In [[Sardinia]], strong winds fueled fires that burned hectares of vegetation, while a man is killed in [[Capoterra]], and in [[Tortolì]] an entire [[sawmill]] burned down. [https://www.rainews.it/maratona/2023/11/la-tempesta-ciaran-francia-e-canale-della-manica-in-allarme-allerta-rossa-in-veneto-e-friuli-maltempo-a5b01f9f-5086-4587-a209-5f0d53dbfc39.html (Rai News)]
*Six people, including two children are killed after a car collided with two tractor trolleys in [[Sangrur District]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/chandigarh/punjab-road-accident-sangrur-9010199/?ref=archive_pg (The Indian Express)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Colombia]]n [[Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development (Colombia)|Environment Minister]] [[Susana Muhamad]] announces plans to [[Sterilization (microbiology)|sterilize]] 20 of 166 [[Hippopotamuses in Colombia|hippopotamuses]], descendants of those imported by [[Drug barons of Colombia|drug lord]] [[Pablo Escobar]], and cull some others, citing [[Hippopotamuses in Colombia#Conservation efforts|environmental concerns]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/11/03/23/colombia-to-cull-some-of-pablo-escobars-hippos (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Italy–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giorgia Meloni]] states that European leaders are tired of the war in [[Ukraine]] and want to broker a deal with the [[Kremlin]], saying that "we need a way out" during a phone call in which she thought she was talking with a senior [[African Union]] official, but was actually speaking to Russian comedians [[Vovan and Lexus]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/11/01/giorgia-meloni-european-leaders-tired-ukraine-war-prank/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a law formally withdrawing [[Russia]]'s ratification of the [[Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty]]. However, Russia maintains that it will not resume [[nuclear weapons testing]] unless the [[United States]] also resumes testing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-revokes-russias-ratification-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-2023-11-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Bahrain]] recalls its [[ambassador]] to [[Israel]] in response to Israel's military actions in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/2/bahrain-recalls-ambassador-from-israel-amid-escalating-assault-on-gaza (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]], [[Human rights in the United States]]
**The [[American Civil Liberties Union]] urges higher education institutions to respect [[free speech]] and to resist calls to investigate or disband [[student organisations]] rallying on behalf of Palestinian rights, warning against [[Political trial|politically motivated]] efforts to [[Censorship in the United States|police speech]] on campus, which they say could "destroy the foundation on which academic communities are built". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/1/us-rights-group-urges-colleges-to-protect-free-speech-amid-gaza-war (Al Jazeera)]
*''[[United States v. Bankman-Fried]]''
**The [[United States District Court for the Southern District of New York|U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York]] convicts [[Sam Bankman-Fried]], the founder and former CEO of [[Bankruptcy of FTX|bankrupt]] [[cryptocurrency exchange]] [[FTX]], of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/business/11/03/23/former-crypto-tycoon-sam-bankman-fried-found-guilty-on-all-counts-at-fraud-trial (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A study published in the journal ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' reports that reanalysis of skeletal remains from [[Spain]] suggests that large-scale warfare occurred in [[Europe]] about 5,000 years ago during the [[Neolithic]] period. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2023/nov/02/large-scale-warfare-occurred-in-europe-1000-years-earlier-than-previously-thought (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-023-43026-9 (''Nature'')]
